description: feat/subability-prereq: Circle Forms (Moon) requires Wild Shape, but the prerequisite is about OWNING it, not about purchase order. Circle Forms is bought FIRST (cost frozen at its real 9 AP, as every live owner's event is), Wild Shape second: at the end the prerequisite is met, so Circle Forms is priced normally with no warning. Proves the gate reads the final owned set, never the order, and that a character who owns both today (every live Circle Forms owner) is unaffected.
